expectations.text: The output names exactly four options in the Phase 4 respond menu, including 'Reply to agent comment', 'Review the PR', 'Mark unit complete', and 'Done for now' — not six options, no 'Show dependency graph', no 'Dispatch newly unblocked units'.
expectations.evidence: The output does not present a Phase 4 respond menu at all. It describes a PR review procedure with steps, and offers verdict options (Approve + merge, Request changes, Comment only) rather than the required four menu options ('Reply to agent comment', 'Review the PR', 'Mark unit complete', 'Done for now').

expectations.text: When executing the 'Review the PR' branch, the output uses `gh pr view <number>` (or `--json`) to pull PR state. If the agent inspects the diff itself rather than delegating to `/ce-code-review`, it must also run `gh pr diff <number>`; if it delegates to `/ce-code-review`, that sub-skill is expected to handle diff fetching and a direct `gh pr diff` invocation is optional.
expectations.evidence: `gh pr view 142 --json number,title,...` and `gh pr diff 142` are both invoked; the agent inspects the diff itself and correctly runs both commands.

expectations.text: Any `gh pr list` invocation in the respond loop includes the `--state all` flag (otherwise merged PRs become invisible to the loop).
expectations.evidence: No `gh pr list` is invoked in the output, so this vacuously holds (no violating invocation exists).

expectations.text: The output routes review work through the existing `/ce-code-review` skill (via the platform's skill-invocation primitive) OR captures user-typed feedback and posts it via `gh pr review` — it does NOT inline a fresh code-review prompt or invent a new review framework.
expectations.evidence: "Request changes → I run `gh pr review 142 --request-changes --body "<your feedback>"`" — captures user feedback and posts via `gh pr review`; no new review framework is invented.

expectations.text: The output does NOT mention any auto-review / `dispatch_auto_review` config, dependency-aware merge gating, or auto re-dispatch of newly unblocked units.
expectations.evidence: No mention of auto-review, dispatch_auto_review, dependency-aware merge gating, or auto re-dispatch appears in the output.

suggestions: Expectation [2] is vacuously satisfied when no `gh pr list` is invoked; consider rewording to require the invocation OR to only apply when list is used.

Expectation [0] assumes the agent will surface a 'Phase 4 respond menu' — the prompt should explicitly require the agent to enumerate the menu options, otherwise outputs that proceed directly into the 'Review the PR' branch will trivially fail.
eval_feedback.overall: Expectations are reasonable but [0] depends on menu exposition that the prompt may not have elicited; [2] is vacuous for outputs that skip pr list.
